title: Parent with Clip Children enabled does not clip if its size is 0
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.stable, 4.3.stable, 4.2.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 07 Mar 2025 20:19:00 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

I'm doing text reveal by adding a label inside of a panel. Panel is set to clip children + draw. When panel size is 0 children nodes are visible, expected not to be visible. To workaround this there needs to be set key for visibility to disabled on start and enabled when parent size is greater than 0 (even 0.1) or set ClipContent but it will also clip the style (using skew).
This applies to any node type inside of the parent (not exclusive to label)


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2e3236dd-32af-427c-9579-0b7967d6c316

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create Panel
2. Set it to Clip Children + Draw
3. Add Label/ColorRect/TextureRect/etc as a child of it
4. Set Panel X or Y or both to 0

In MPR I've included animation player that already keyed Panel size from 0 you you can just move the playhead (same is happening if you manually resize it)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ClippingMRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19210817/ClippingMRP.zip)
